sample_unit: pediatric cardiac intensive care unit notes

links.outcome: Differences between parent and clinician ratings of LLM-generated clinical summaries
links.effect: Parents and clinicians differed importantly on helpfulness; clinicians gave insight on clinical accuracy and parents on readability. No numeric results are reported in the abstract.
links.quote: There were important discrepancies between parents and clinicians in the realm of helpfulness, along with important insights by clinicians assessing clinical accuracy and parents assessing readability.

unlisted_practices: Dual-perspective (clinician plus parent) evaluation framework for LLM-generated clinical summaries

screen.reason: Retrospective study evaluating LLM-generated summaries of ICU notes using dual-perspective ratings from clinicians and parents, without evaluating a specific operational guardrail or deployment practice.
